scenes.extra: one single giant snow globe standing alone on the floor, a round clear glass sphere resting on a wide pale wooden base, the glass sphere is three times as tall as she is, the whole globe fits inside the frame, she sits small in the middle of the wooden base with her knees pressed to her chest and her feet tucked in close to her hips, her shoes rest on the wooden base well inside the glass, the glass wall passes in front of her shoes and her knees, the glass covers her from every side, her arms are wrapped around her shins, white flakes drift slowly through the water inside the sphere, caustics on the floor, glossy reflective floor, limited palette, white wall, hard sunlight, large shadow, ink splatter
scenes.scene_nl: a single giant snow globe stands alone on the floor and its round clear glass sphere rests on a wide pale wooden base. she sits small in the middle of the wooden base with her knees pressed to her chest and her feet tucked in close to her hips. a wide ring of empty base circles her. her arms are wrapped around her shins. her shoes rest on the base well inside the glass and the glass wall passes in front of her shoes and her knees while the glass covers her from every side. white flakes drift slowly through the water inside the sphere. sunlight rings the floor with bright caustics. she is the only person in the picture.

scenes.zh: 花园俯拍 · 巨型鸟笼
scenes.desc: 笼内俯拍花园花海：机位进到巨型鸟笼内部，笼条沿画框上缘退成背景，笼底无底座直通花海；人物坐在花丛里背靠笼条、仰头睁眼看着上方，双腿向前伸，身体沿画面对角线
scenes.extra: the whole frame is a flat overhead view of a flower field, seen from directly above, seen from inside an enormous gilded birdcage, gilded cage rods rise along the top edge of the picture behind her, the bottom of the cage opens straight onto the flower field, the cage is enormous and its round floor is many times wider than she is, a wide ring of white flowers lies open around her, she sits on the white flowers with her back against the curve of the cage, her legs stretch out in front of her along the diagonal of the frame, her head tips back against the bars and her eyes are open as she looks up, her lips are gently closed, her hands lie loose in her lap, her hair spills over the flowers beside her, the white flower field continues outside the cage in bright light, bright soft daylight, long soft shadows, limited palette, ink splatter
scenes.scene_nl: seen from above inside an enormous gilded birdcage. gilded cage rods rise along the top edge of the picture behind her. the cage is enormous and its round floor is many times wider than she is and a wide ring of white flowers lies open around her. she sits on the white flowers with her back against the curve of the cage and her legs stretch out in front of her along the diagonal of the frame. her head tips back against the bars and her eyes are open as she looks up and her lips are gently closed. her hands lie loose in her lap and her hair spills over the flowers beside her. the white flower field continues outside the cage in bright light. she is the only person in the picture.

scenes.zh: 花园俯拍 · 花海仰躺熟睡
scenes.desc: 垂直俯拍花海，人物仰面平躺在白花丛中熟睡、双腿伸直、双手搭在身侧，身体沿画面对角线（无鸟笼无道具）
scenes.extra: the whole frame is a flat overhead view of a flower field, seen from directly above, white flowers fill the whole frame, she lies on her back on the white flowers, her body runs from the lower left corner to the upper right corner, her legs are stretched out straight on the flowers, her arms rest open on the flowers beside her, her cheek rests on the petals with her eyes shut, her lashes rest on her cheek and her lips are gently closed, her hair fans out through the flowers, white petals drift over her clothes, soft daylight, long soft shadows, limited palette, ink splatter
scenes.scene_nl: a flat overhead view of a flower field with white flowers filling the whole frame. she lies on her back on the flowers with her body running from the lower left corner to the upper right corner. her legs are stretched out straight and her arms rest open on the flowers beside her. her cheek rests on the petals with her eyes shut and her lashes resting on her cheek and her lips gently closed as she sleeps. her hair fans out through the flowers and white petals drift over her clothes. she is the only person in the picture.

scenes.zh: 双色对角 · 巨幅自画像
scenes.desc: 参考图构图：左半是她自己面部特写的巨幅印刷海报，小人在右前方侧身站立回望镜头，深蓝占左上、白压右下的硬边对角双色，蓝色墨点四散
scenes.extra: a giant close-up portrait of her own face fills the left half of the picture as a printed poster, the printed eyes look straight out of the picture, she stands small in the lower right in front of the poster, her body is turned in three-quarter view with her face toward the viewer, two-tone background, deep navy blue fills the upper left, white fills the lower right, diagonal split from bottom left to top right, sharp diagonal color edge, flat graphic background, hard sunlight, large shadow, limited palette, ink splatter
scenes.scene_nl: a giant close-up portrait of her own face fills the left half of the picture as a printed poster and the printed eyes look straight out of it. she stands small in the lower right in front of the poster with her body turned in three-quarter view and her face toward the viewer. behind them the background is cut by one hard diagonal edge with deep navy blue in the upper left and white in the lower right. blue ink splatter scatters across the white. she is the only person in the picture.

scenes.zh: 巨型黑胶 · 中心孔张臂
scenes.desc: 巨黑胶立起如拱门，人物站在中心孔里张开双臂
scenes.extra: gigantic vinyl record standing on edge, vinyl grooves, record label, limited palette, white wall, hard sunlight, large shadow, ink splatter
scenes.scene_nl: a gigantic vinyl record stands on edge behind her like a dark archway and its grooves rise above her head. she stands in front of it with both arms spread wide and her hands rest on the rim. the background behind her is cut by one hard diagonal edge. she is the only person in the picture.

scenes.zh: 花园俯拍 · 巨型草帽
scenes.desc: 俯拍平面：巨型草帽平躺在花海，人物是从正上方看到的小形状；去掉诱发脸部特写的睫毛句
scenes.extra: the whole frame is a flat overhead view of a flower field, seen from directly above, an enormous straw hat lies flat on the white flowers, the hat is seen from directly above so its woven brim makes one wide circle, she lies on her back on top of the hat and her body covers its middle, her body runs from the lower left corner to the upper right corner, her legs are stretched out and her feet reach the far edge of the brim, the wide brim spreads out past her on both sides, her hair spills over the straw, soft daylight, long soft shadows, limited palette, ink splatter, one enormous flat circular straw disc lies empty on the flowers, its brim is many times wider than her whole body, her whole figure is seen from directly above as one small shape
scenes.scene_nl: a flat overhead view of a white flower field. one enormous straw hat lies flat and empty on the flowers with its round woven brim many times wider than her whole body. her whole figure is seen from directly above as one small shape lying flat at the centre of the crown with her legs stretched out. the wide brim spreads past her on both sides. she is the only person in the picture.

scenes.zh: 巨型琴键 · 阶梯行走
scenes.desc: 俯视摄影：巨型黑键白键铺成宽阔阶梯向上延伸，人物在琴键楼梯上抬脚行走
scenes.extra: enormous piano keys form a wide staircase, every key has a tall white riser under it so the keys stack like real steps, black keys and white keys step up the picture in long bands, seen from above so the steps rise away from the viewer, she walks up the keys with one foot lifted onto the next step, each key is wider than she is tall, the keyboard runs out of the frame at the top, white wall, hard sunlight, large shadow, limited palette, ink splatter
scenes.scene_nl: seen from above enormous piano keys form a wide staircase and every key has a tall riser under it so the keys stack like real steps and the black and white steps rise away from the viewer. she walks up the keys with one foot lifted onto the next step and each step is wider than she is tall. the keyboard runs out of the frame at the top. she is the only person in the picture.

scenes.zh: 巨型钟面 · 立于指针
scenes.desc: 巨钟面嵌在墙里，人物站在长指针上
scenes.extra: gigantic clock face, clock hands, roman numerals, limited palette, white wall, hard sunlight, large shadow, ink splatter
scenes.scene_nl: a gigantic clock face is set into the white wall and she balances on one of its long hands. the dial is many times her height.

scenes.zh: 流星夜空 · 巨伞坠落
scenes.desc: 黑夜高空俯拍：人物撑着大伞在半空脚朝下急速坠落，双腿自然卷曲并朝向下方，画面下方没有任何地面，夜空铺满星海与斜划而过的流星
scenes.extra: black night sky all around her, a sea of small stars fills the black night sky, long bright meteors streak diagonally across the black night sky, tiny star trails and wind streaks around her, her whole body is upright and she falls feet first through the night, her legs point down toward the bottom of the picture and her feet are the lowest part of her body, her legs curl naturally as she falls, she holds an open umbrella and its canopy is tilted at her side, the umbrella ribs fan across the top of the picture, her hair and her sleeves stream upward past her head, the lower part of the picture stays empty black night sky, soft starlight, limited palette, ink splatter
scenes.scene_nl: black night sky fills the frame around her and a sea of small stars spreads across it. long bright meteors streak diagonally through the night and tiny star trails follow the wind. her whole body is upright and she falls feet first with her legs pointing down toward the bottom of the picture and her feet the lowest part of her body. her legs curl naturally as she falls and she holds an open umbrella whose canopy is tilted at her side. the umbrella ribs fan across the top of the picture and her hair and her sleeves stream upward past her head and the lower part of the picture stays empty black night sky. she is the only person in the picture.

scenes.zh: 花园俯拍 · 巨型标本框
scenes.desc: 垂直俯拍花园花海：一只又高又宽的巨型玻璃标本框，四面玻璃壁远高于人物，人物站在框正中央、四周留出一整圈压花，玻璃盖合在她头顶之上
scenes.extra: the whole frame is a flat overhead view of a flower field, seen from directly above, one single very tall glass specimen case stands alone on the lawn, the case is the only glass object in the picture, its glass wall is taller than she is, the case is broad and its glass stands well away from her body, a wide empty margin of white flowers lies around her inside the case, she stands small in the middle of the case, the glass lid closes far above her head, pale silver edging on the tall glass case, bright green lawn around the case, soft daylight, long soft shadows, limited palette, ink splatter
scenes.scene_nl: from directly above one single very tall glass specimen case rests alone on the lawn and the case is the only glass object in the picture. its glass wall is taller than she is and the case is broad with the glass standing well away from her body. a wide empty margin of white flowers lies around her inside the case and she stands small in the middle with the glass lid closing far above her head. bright green grass surrounds the case. she is the only person in the picture.

scenes.zh: 巨型拉链 · 双手拉开
scenes.desc: 巨拉链把白墙分开，人物在墙后、从裂开的缝隙里双手把两片墙向外拉开
scenes.extra: one gigantic metal zipper splits a tall white wall down the middle, the two wall halves peel apart like two opened panels, she stands behind the wall and is seen only through the long opening between the halves, both her hands grip the inner edges of the wall from behind and pull the halves wider, the white wall is in front of her, the dark gap frames her whole figure, clean white plaster surface, hard sunlight, large shadow, symmetry, limited palette
scenes.scene_nl: a gigantic metal zipper splits a tall white wall down the middle and the two wall halves peel apart. she stands behind the wall and is framed inside the long dark opening with both hands gripping the inner edges from behind to pull the halves wider. the white wall is in front of her and the gap reveals her from head to toe. she is the only person in the picture.

scenes.zh: 花园俯拍 · 巨型信封
scenes.desc: 垂直俯拍花园花海，a giant paper envelope —— 人物置身其中，动作安静
scenes.extra: the whole frame is a flat overhead view of a flower field, seen from directly above, giant paper envelope, folded flap, pressed flowers, scattered petals, green grass, soft daylight, long soft shadows, limited palette, ink splatter
scenes.scene_nl: looking down from above a giant paper envelope lies open on a lawn. she sits cross-legged on its folded flap among pressed flowers and loose petals. the grass around the envelope is thick and green. she is small among the flowers. she is the only person in the picture.

scenes.desc: 巨胶片卷成高环，人物悬浮在环心
scenes.extra: gigantic film strip curled into a ring, sprocket holes, white wall, hard sunlight, large shadow, glass shards, ink splatter
scenes.scene_nl: a gigantic film strip curls into a tall ring behind her and the sprocket holes run around it like a frame. she stands in front of the ring with both arms slightly out. she is the only person in the picture.

scenes.zh: 巨型水族箱 · 跪姿望鱼
scenes.desc: 跪在巨水族墙外，一手贴玻璃，鱼群在厚蓝玻璃后游动
scenes.extra: gigantic aquarium wall, thick blue glass, fish, water, white wall, hard sunlight, large shadow, interior of a tiled aquarium room
scenes.scene_nl: a gigantic aquarium wall stands before her with fish drifting behind thick blue glass. she kneels small outside it with one hand on the surface.

scenes.desc: 无尽镜面回廊把身影复制到远处，人站在正中背对镜头
scenes.extra: endless corridor of mirrors, reflections, white wall, hard sunlight, large shadow, interior of an empty mirrored hall
scenes.scene_nl: an endless corridor of mirrors repeats her small figure into the distance. she stands alone in its centre and is seen from behind.

scenes.zh: 巨型齿轮 · 坐齿悬腿
scenes.desc: 把「坐齿悬腿」写成屈膝、双腿悬空的几何坐姿，避免画成站立
scenes.extra: gigantic clockwork gears, gear teeth, white wall, hard sunlight, large shadow, ink splatter, she sits on the edge of one gear tooth, both knees bent, both legs hanging freely, her whole small figure seen from a distance
scenes.scene_nl: gigantic clockwork gears are embedded in the wall around her and their teeth are taller than she is. she sits on the edge of one low tooth with both knees bent and both legs hanging freely. her whole small figure is seen from a distance between the gears. she is the only person in the picture.

scenes.zh: 花园俯拍 · 巨型玫瑰窗
scenes.desc: 删掉 rose petals（会被读成玫瑰花），改写成圆形彩色玻璃窗平躺在草地
scenes.extra: the whole frame is a flat overhead view of a flower field, seen from directly above, giant rose window, stained glass, coloured light on the grass, soft daylight, long soft shadows, limited palette, ink splatter, one giant circular leaded stained glass window lies flat on the grass, stone tracery radiates from its centre like a wheel, coloured glass panes cast light on the ground, the window is many times wider than her whole body
scenes.scene_nl: from straight above one giant circular stained glass window lies flat in the garden. stone tracery radiates from its centre like a wheel and coloured glass panes cast light on the grass. the window is many times wider than her whole body and she kneels as a tiny figure at its centre. she is the only person in the picture.

scenes.desc: 远景俯拍，埃舍尔式无尽阶梯自我折叠，人物只占一小段
scenes.extra: endless impossible staircase, escher stairs, white wall, hard sunlight, large shadow, ink splatter
scenes.scene_nl: seen from far above. an endless impossible staircase folds back into itself and she climbs one small flight. the structure dwarfs her.

scenes.zh: 花园俯拍 · 巨型蒲公英
scenes.desc: 俯拍平面：单个巨型蒲公英球占半幅，人物是从上方看到的小形状
scenes.extra: the whole frame is a flat overhead view of a flower field, seen from directly above, gigantic dandelion seed head, floating seeds, white and yellow wildflowers, green grass blades, soft daylight, long soft shadows, limited palette, ink splatter, one single spherical seed head many times wider than her whole body fills half the frame, her whole figure is seen from directly above as a small shape lying flat beside it
scenes.scene_nl: looking straight down at a field of small wildflowers one single gigantic spherical dandelion seed head fills half the frame and is many times wider than her whole body. her whole figure is seen from directly above as a small shape lying flat on the grass beside it. she is the only person in the picture.

scenes.zh: 巨纸撕口 · 穿越回望
scenes.desc: 整张巨白纸被撕开，人物跨过裂口回头
scenes.extra: paper tear, jagged paper edge, white paper, split paper, white wall, hard sunlight, large shadow, ink splatter
scenes.scene_nl: a giant sheet of white paper is torn open across the whole picture and she steps through the jagged tear and looks back. the tear is far taller than she is.

scenes.zh: 花园俯拍 · 巨型钥匙孔

scenes.scene_nl: from high above a stone slab lies flat in a flower field and a giant keyhole is cut right through it. her whole figure is seen from directly above as one compact curled shape with both knees drawn tight against her chest and both arms around her shins. white daisies grow around the edge of the stone. she is the only person in the picture.

scenes.desc: 垂直俯拍花园花海，a giant ornate mirror frame —— 人物置身其中，动作安静
scenes.extra: the whole frame is a flat overhead view of a flower field, seen from directly above, giant ornate mirror frame, one cracked pane, moss on the frame, flower field reflected in the glass, soft daylight, long soft shadows, limited palette, ink splatter
scenes.scene_nl: looking down from above a giant ornate mirror frame lies flat on a lawn and the flower field is reflected inside its glass. she stands at the centre of the frame with her arms at her sides. moss grows along the carved edge. she is small among the flowers. she is the only person in the picture.

scenes.zh: 花园俯拍 · 巨型书页
scenes.desc: 垂直俯拍花园花海，a giant open book —— 人物置身其中，动作安静
scenes.extra: the whole frame is a flat overhead view of a flower field, seen from directly above, giant open book, printed pages, ivy creeping over the cover, grass and small flowers, soft daylight, long soft shadows, limited palette, ink splatter
scenes.scene_nl: from directly above a giant open book lies on a garden lawn and its printed pages fill the centre of the frame. she sits on one page with her legs folded to the side. ivy creeps over the cover and small flowers grow between the grass blades. she is small among the flowers. she is the only person in the picture.

scenes.desc: 黑底逆光，巨雪花球只剩一道亮边，人物抱膝坐在球内底座上成剪影，玻璃完整罩住全身

scenes.scene_nl: in the dark a single giant snow globe rests on the floor and its round clear glass sphere sits on a wide pale wooden base. she sits small in the middle of the wooden base with her knees pressed to her chest and her feet tucked in close to her hips. a wide ring of empty base circles her. her arms are wrapped around her shins. her shoes rest on the base well inside the glass and the glass wall passes in front of her shoes and her knees while the glass covers her from every side. the light comes from behind and draws one bright arc along the edge of the glass while the rest of the frame stays black. she is the only person in the picture.

scenes.desc: 黑底逆光：发光几何马赛克砖墙从黑暗里升起，人物背身回望
scenes.extra: an enormous wall of glowing square glass tiles, each tile holds a different abstract mosaic, dots, grids, stepped diamonds, pure abstract geometry, black background, hard sunlight from behind, silhouette, glossy reflective floor, long shadow on the floor, limited palette
scenes.scene_nl: an enormous wall of glowing square tiles rises out of the dark and each tile holds a different abstract mosaic of dots grids and stepped diamonds. she walks small at its foot and turns her head back toward the viewer. she is the only person in the picture.

scenes.desc: 巨大齿轮嵌在黑暗里，人物坐在齿上垂腿
scenes.extra: gigantic clockwork gears, gear teeth, black background, hard sunlight from behind, silhouette, glossy reflective floor, long shadow on the floor, glass shards, ink splatter, limited palette
scenes.scene_nl: gigantic clockwork gears are embedded in the dark around her and their teeth are taller than she is. she sits small on one tooth with her legs dangling.

scenes.extra: gigantic keyhole cut into the wall, backlit opening, black background, hard sunlight from behind, silhouette, glossy reflective floor, long shadow on the floor, glass shards, ink splatter, limited palette, one compact curled ball, both knees tight against her chest, both arms around her shins, her whole small figure sits at the centre of the lit circle
scenes.scene_nl: a gigantic keyhole of light is cut into the dark and the keyhole is many times her height. her whole small figure sits at the centre of the lit circle as one compact curled ball with both knees tight against her chest and both arms around her shins. she is the only person in the picture.

scenes.desc: 深蓝墙面嵌巨钟面，人物站在长指针上
scenes.extra: gigantic clock face, clock hands, roman numerals, deep navy blue background, hard sunlight, large shadow, glossy reflective floor, glass shards, ink splatter, limited palette
scenes.scene_nl: a gigantic clock face is set into a deep blue wall and she balances on one of its long hands. the dial is many times her height.

scenes.desc: 巨胶片卷成高环，人物悬浮在环心
scenes.extra: gigantic film strip curled into a ring, sprocket holes, deep navy blue background, hard sunlight, large shadow, glossy reflective floor, glass shards, ink splatter, limited palette
scenes.scene_nl: a gigantic film strip curls into a tall ring behind her against the deep blue wall and the sprocket holes run around it like a frame. she stands in front of the ring with both arms slightly out. she is the only person in the picture.

scenes.desc: 深蓝海底：人物沉入水中，水面在上方远处、海床在下方，光柱与气泡环绕
scenes.extra: underwater, deep open sea, sinking slowly toward the seabed, shafts of sunlight slanting down from the bright water surface far above, bubbles rising around her, small fish drifting past her, her long hair floating upward, deep navy blue water, soft blue caustics, sandy seabed far below, limited palette, quiet blue light
scenes.scene_nl: she sinks slowly through deep blue water with the bright surface far above her and a dim seabed far below. thin shafts of sunlight reach down through the water and small bubbles trail upward around her. small fish drift past her on both sides. she is the only person in the picture.

scenes.desc: 深蓝无尽镜廊把身影复制到远处，人物背身独立
scenes.extra: endless corridor of mirrors, reflections, deep navy blue background, hard sunlight, large shadow, glossy reflective floor, glass shards, ink splatter, limited palette, interior of an empty mirrored hall
scenes.scene_nl: an endless corridor of mirrors repeats her small figure into the darkness. she stands alone in its centre and is seen from behind.

scenes.desc: 巨拉链把血红色墙撕开，人物双手向两侧拉开
scenes.extra: gigantic zipper, metal zipper track, zipper slider, long seam splitting the wall, crimson red background, hard sunlight, large shadow, glossy reflective floor, glass shards, ink splatter, limited palette
scenes.scene_nl: a gigantic zipper splits the red wall open along one long seam. she grips the metal slider with both hands and drags it down. only one small figure stands in the opening.

scenes.zh: 花园俯拍 · 鸟笼红调
scenes.desc: 垂直俯拍花园花海，an enormous birdcage —— 人物置身其中，动作安静

scenes.scene_nl: looking straight down through the top of an enormous red birdcage its bars cross the frame like a wheel. she sits inside on the cage floor among red petals. the shadow of the grid falls on the grass outside. she is small among the flowers. she is the only person in the picture.

scenes.scene_nl: a top down view of a garden shows one giant circular stained glass window lying flat in the grass. stone tracery radiates from its centre and deep red glass panes cast red light over the ground. the window is many times wider than her whole body and she kneels as a tiny figure at its centre. she is the only person in the picture.

scenes.zh: 花园俯拍 · 信封红调
scenes.desc: 垂直俯拍花园花海，a giant red paper envelope —— 人物置身其中，动作安静
scenes.extra: the whole frame is a flat overhead view of a flower field, seen from directly above, giant red paper envelope, folded flap, red petals, dark green leaves, soft daylight, long soft shadows, limited palette, ink splatter
